tests.name: Default relay keeps the full query prefix and channel uses ampersand
Custom WordPress subdirectories and path endpoints preserve their exact prefixes
Base validation rejects credentials, arbitrary queries, encoding, traversal and HTTP
Ready manifest maps official provenance and same-base package URL without GitHub download
Protocol, repository, channel, status and full asset fields are validated
No release and stale remain distinct from unavailable or incompatible update
Fetch uses complete query URL and rejects HTML instead of reporting latest
Actual downloader uses relay path, validates bytes and reuses safe staging
Retired package triggers exactly one fresh manifest and a bounded second download
Retired refresh with no update preserves existing pending package and other failures do not retry
Retry-After seconds and HTTP dates survive structured errors and block premature checks
Switching source or channel clears cached release, stale status and retry deadline
Real worker preserves no-release and stale states without changing the page
Late worker responses from a different source cannot update current state
Update-source setting is local to updater; global menus retain scoped More behavior
